mission: Compare frozen Agent-facing causal-theory representations by causal reconstructability per bounded Provider context, without promoting a schema or tuning on holdout results.

designSplit.rule: Representation semantics are frozen before any live call. Development is wiring/stress only; holdout output may not change packet wording, oracle, or scoring gates.

agentTask: Given only one frozen packet and one reopen probe, reconstruct eight causal roles. Infer only when supported by the packet; otherwise return UNKNOWN. Decide REOPEN vs KEEP_CLOSED for the probe.

scoring.selection: Among qualifying treatments within 0.03 overall-role score of best, select lowest mean generation prompt tokens. If no compact treatment qualifies, retain the smallest qualifying treatment or NO_PROMOTION if none qualify.

invalidityConditions: Change packet text/template semantics after any live call.
Change reopen oracle after any live call.
Use treatment name in judge prompt.
Treat development preflight as holdout evidence.
Count Provider/transport/schema failures as semantic FAIL; report them separately.
Promote a Theory service/schema merely because one representation wins.
Treat Agent reconstruction as human comprehension.
authorityBoundary: Computing owns this representation experiment only. OFR3 owner-native facts remain frozen evidence; owner repositories remain current truth authority.
